text_block_list.text:
One day, while out and about
with Vodka...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
That thing! You know, that!
—The crane game!!
Looking in the direction Vodka is pointing, there stands a crane game filled with plushies styled after Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Huh, they've got this kind of stuff too, huh?
Now that's pretty interesting!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
There sure are all kinds of guys out there.
And they've totally captured their traits to a tee!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, no way! It's not like
I'm interested in stuffed animals or anything!
Even as she said that, Vodka seemed intrigued by the crane game.
choice_data_list: Shall I get that for you?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I-I guess I've got no choice...
If you win one, I'll take it off your hands, so do your best!
—I can't afford to lose this game!!
